title: 薄明の書架と、眠らぬラジオ
author: 渡会 はる

en.title: The Twilight Bookshelf and the Sleepless Radio
en.premise: After inheriting his grandfather's secondhand bookstore, a young man named Minato discovers notes tucked within the pages—notes that read like "replies to someone." They are the traces of a quiet dialogue left behind by Shiori, a woman who lived a solitary life while battling an incurable illness. Finding solace in a shared dawn radio program, their words begin to intertwine, drawing them closer to the delicate boundary between life and death.

zh.title: 《薄明书架与不眠广播》
zh.premise: 继承了祖父留下的旧书店的青年·凑，在藏书中偶然发现了一些宛如“给某人的回信”般的笔记。那是身患绝症、孤独生活的女性·栞，试图通过书籍留给世界的静谧对话。以黎明时分的广播节目为共同的寄托，两人通过文字交谈，在生与死的边界相互依偎。
